references.text: Here the number of men from the tribe of Judah who were counted is given: 74,600. This forms the basis for the total number in Judah's camp mentioned in Num 2:9.
Describes how Judah's camp broke camp first when the Israelites left Sinai, fulfilling the instruction that they should set out first.
These verses give details about the three tribes that made up Judah's camp (Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun) and their respective numbers, which are summed in verse 9.
Jacob's blessing over Judah foretells the tribe's leadership position among his brothers, reflected in Judah's camp having the place of honor to the east and leading when the people set out.
The number counted from the tribe of Issachar (54,400), which was part of Judah's camp.
The number counted from the tribe of Zebulun (57,400), which was part of Judah's camp.
